t: Open Source SEO: My Journey to Codebase Consolidation
s: The author unifies disparate SEO projects (Botifython and Pipulate) into a single codebase, Pipulate, by implementing flexible app naming logic via directory names or an `app_name.txt` file, simplifying development and enabling public release.
sub: Codebase unification of Botifython and Pipulate
Dynamic application naming strategy using directory and file overrides
Rebasing project history and public release of Pipulate
Distinguishing lightweight FOSS SEO from enterprise SaaS
